Large feedback resistors keep the output unloaded. Capacitors in matching ratios cancel the virtual-ground pole. The resistor ratios are pre-distorted for the finite loop gain of ~32-38 dB. Headroom: tail node ≈0.3 V and diode node ≈0.75 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 8.0, 22.0),       # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.2, 1.0),         # input pair L
    "gmid3": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),        # PMOS mirror load L
    "itail": (55e-6, 20e-6, 62e-6),   # tail current
    "gmidt": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),       # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Rf":    (300e3, 50e3, 2e6),      # feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (150e-15, 30e-15, 600e-15),  # feedback capacitor (cancels vx pole)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    g1t, g2t = 0.1571, 0.01797          # target |gains| (centres of the spec windows)
    it = p["itail"]
    i1 = it / 2.0

    # ---- input pair: iterate on tail-node voltage (body effect) ----
    vt = 0.3
    vd1 = 0.75
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vd1 - vt, 0.2), vsb=vt)
        vt = max(0.9 - m1.vgs, 0.1)
        m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=1.05)
        m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=m3.vgs)
        vd1 = 1.8 - m3.vgs
    # output-side devices: vout = 0.9 V
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(0.9 - vt, 0.2), vsb=vt)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.9)

    # ---- tail and reference mirror (same L and gm/Id) ----
    Lt = 1.0
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], Lt, it, vds=vt)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], Lt, iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], Lt, iref, vds=m5.vgs)

    # ---- feedback network, with ratios pre-distorted for finite loop gain ----
    Rf = p["Rf"]
    gm = m2.gm
    gout = m2.gds + m4.gds
    R1 = Rf / g1t
    R2 = Rf / g2t
    for _ in range(4):
        Rp = 1.0 / (1.0 / R1 + 1.0 / R2)
        beta = Rp / (Rp + Rf)
        A = gm / (gout + 1.0 / (Rf + Rp))
        T = A * beta
        k = T / (1.0 + T)
        R1 = Rf * k / g1t
        R2 = Rf * k / g2t
    Cf = p["Cf"]
    C1 = Cf * Rf / R1
    C2 = Cf * Rf / R2

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # OTA: M1 gate = vcm (non-inverting), M2 gate = vx (inverting), output at M2/M4 drain
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vx", "tail", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M5", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # summing network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vx", R1)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vx", R2)
    n.R("Rf", "vx", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("C1", "vin1", "vx", C1)
    n.C("C2", "vin2", "vx", C2)
    n.C("Cf", "vx", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- predictions ----
    Rp = 1.0 / (1.0 / R1 + 1.0 / R2)
    beta = Rp / (Rp + Rf)
    A = gm / (gout + 1.0 / (Rf + Rp))
    T = A * beta
    k = T / (1.0 + T)
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * k
    a2 = -(Rf / R2) * k
    Cp = m2.cgg
    Csum = C1 + C2 + Cp
    beta_hf = Cf / (Cf + Csum)
    Cload = cl + m2.cdd + m4.cdd + Cf * Csum / (Cf + Csum)
    bw = beta_hf * gm / (2 * PI * Cload)
    power = 1.8 * (iref + it)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": a2, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": 0.0, "power": power}
